newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NatWest Australia reports higher year profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NatWest Australia reports higher year profit.

text.p: Investment bank NatWest Markets Australia Ltd on Tuesday reported an operating profit before tax of A$70.5 million for 1996, a 40 percent increase over 1995.

NatWest Markets Australia, part of the National Westminster Bank Plc group, said net profit rose to A$68.07 million in 1996 from A$48.35 million in 1995, while interest income rose to A$212.87 million from A$197.59 million.
NatWest Markets Australia chief executive Peter St George said the results reflected the strength and diversity of its business in Australia, with all divisions improving performance.
"In financial markets, our traded debt and derivatives business enjoyed higher volumes and increased customer business, maintaining their strong market position," St George said in a statement.
The corporate finance division showed a strong improvement in profits, reflecting a much higher deal flow with a number of large high profile transactions to its credit, he said.

NatWest said the equities division maintained its position as Australia's largest stockbroker in terms of the Australian Stock Exchange market turnover and it was ranked second for new equity issues in Australia over 1996.
